notes: שׁוּב → *go again* heads on *again*, which carries the returning lexeme while *go* is the supplied motion verb; heading on *go* was the competing reading (rules 8, 44).
The construct מַעֲשֵׂה takes a supplied *the* with no article morpheme present, and the *of* of *the work of thy hands* goes to the rectum, discontinuous around the possessive (rules 19, 25, 29).
